thread.title: Cypress Semi: Apple Supplier Rises on Q4 Beat

author: Tiernan Ray
title: Cypress Semi: Apple Supplier Rises on Q4 Beat
text:
Chip vendor Cypress Semiconductor ( CY ), a prominent supplier to Apple ( AAPL ), this afternoon reported Q4 revenue and profit that both topped analysts' expectations, and forecast this quarter's revenue and profit higher as well, sending its stock up in late trading.
Revenue in the three months ended in December rose to $597.5 million, yielding EPS of 28 cents.
Analysts had been modeling revenue of $593 million and earnings per share of 25 cents.
For the current quarter, the company sees revenue of $565 million to $595 million, and EPS of 22 cents to 26 cents, versus consensus of $577 million and 22 cents.
Cypress shares are up 33 cents, or 1.9%, at $17.49, in late trading.
